entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thanks for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you?
Hi, I need to start a return. Order number is VF55-82190.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up... I see the ClubFit Jersey. To make sure I'm routing this correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey?
It's the wrong size. It's way too tight in the shoulders. I need to send it back.
I understand. And is it a technical fault with the material, or a preference on the fit?
It's the fit. It's just the wrong size. Can I return it, or do I need to do an exchange? Just tell me what the process is.

Of course. Let me just verify the return eligibility... Okay, I see the delivery was 30 days ago. According to our policy, standard items like this jersey are eligible for return within 90 days. You're well within the window.
Great. So you can process it?

Yes, absolutely. I've just authorized the return in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to your email now. You can use that to send the jersey back for a full refund. The email also has a link if you'd prefer to start an exchange for a different size.
Okay, I see the email coming through now. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
